Flag Atlas / AI & writing tools
Gboard Flag Atlas · Topic guide

AI & writing tools

On-device language models, AI rewriting, proofreading and writing assistance.

18 independently described entries · 50 identifiers in the searchable catalog

Flag explanations

Genai Cachedisable_genai_cacheTurns off caching for generative AI, so repeated requests may require additional processing.Agentic Dictationenable_agentic_dictationUses Rambler-style voice typing, which can clean up dictated text and follow spoken editing instructions.AI Core LLMenable_ai_core_llmEnables Gboard to use language-model capabilities through Android AI Core, an on-device AI service; the consuming feature is unspecified.Grammar Checkerenable_grammar_checkerMakes grammar-aware corrections available in Gboard's text-correction settings; language resources are still required.Grammar Checker On Webviewenable_grammar_checker_on_webviewMakes grammar checking available in compatible embedded web editors.LLM Based Grammar Checkerenable_llm_based_grammar_checkerUses a large language model to check grammar in text and identify potential grammatical issues.On Device Proofreadenable_on_device_proofreadProofreading in Writing Tools can use a built-in lightweight on-device model when compatible local inference resources exist.Smart Edit Apply For Smart Dictationenable_smart_edit_apply_for_smart_dictationSmart dictation can apply text-editing instructions to text, rather than only entering dictated words.Writing Tools Compact Layoutenable_writing_tools_compact_layoutPresents Writing Tools in a more compact layout, taking up less screen space.Writing Tools Cooperative Modeenable_writing_tools_cooperative_modeWriting Tools can use an app’s editing context during text changes, rather than treating selected text as an isolated input.Writing Tools For Minorsenable_writing_tools_for_minorsIncludes accounts classified as minors in Writing Tools eligibility checks; other safety and availability restrictions still apply.Writing Tools My Styleenable_writing_tools_my_styleAdds controls for tailoring Writing Tools rewrites to a preferred writing style.Writing Tools My Style Plusenable_writing_tools_my_style_plusEnables an expanded personalized writing-style experience in Gboard's Writing Tools.Writing Tools Replace Buttonenable_writing_tools_replace_buttonA replace action appears alongside Writing Tools results, offering a way to use the suggested text.Writing Tools Suggest Styleenable_writing_tools_suggest_styleWriting Tools can offer suggested styles to choose from when rewriting text.Writing Tools V2enable_writing_tools_v2Provides Gboard’s newer Writing Tools workflow for editing and rewriting text, subject to service eligibility and supported-language limits.Writing Tools V2 On Toolbarenable_writing_tools_v2_on_toolbarAdds an entry point to the toolbar for Gboard’s newer Writing Tools workflow.Writing Tools Voice Commandsenable_writing_tools_voice_commandsAllows spoken instructions within Writing Tools to request edits or rewrites of selected text.

Flag Atlas / Emoji & expression
Gboard Flag Atlas · Topic guide

Emoji & expression

Emoji Kitchen, stickers, GIFs, and expressive search and suggestions.

28 independently described entries · 93 identifiers in the searchable catalog

Flag explanations

3d Couple Emojisenable_3d_couple_emojisSelects an experimental three-dimensional presentation for couple emoji when Gboard has compatible artwork available.Animated Emoji Content Suggestionsenable_animated_emoji_content_suggestionsAdds animated emoji-style items to Gboard’s content suggestions, making them available alongside other suggested rich content.Contextual GIF Search Query Suggestionenable_contextual_gif_search_query_suggestionOffers GIF search query suggestions based on the text context, helping users find relevant GIFs without typing a full search.Custom Sticker Lol Fixenable_custom_sticker_lol_fixApplies a fix to the custom-sticker feature identified as “LOL.” The exact bug isn't documented, but this isn't a general sticker switch.Custom Sticker Tabenable_custom_sticker_tabAdds a dedicated tab for custom stickers in Gboard, providing a separate place to access sticker-creation features.Dynamic Artenable_dynamic_artMakes Dynamic Art sticker generation available as an expression option, alongside existing sticker assets.Emoji Embedding Indexenable_emoji_embedding_indexUses meaning-based emoji search, so users can find emoji without matching the exact words.Emoji Group Candidate UIenable_emoji_group_candidate_uiPresents emoji suggestions as grouped candidates in the suggestion area, rather than as one flat sequence.Emoji Kitchen Browse Entry Point V2enable_emoji_kitchen_browse_entry_point_v2Shows a newer button for browsing Emoji Kitchen combinations; the button alone cannot unlock a browser unavailable on this build.Emoji Kitchen For Zero State Emojisenable_emoji_kitchen_for_zero_state_emojisMakes Emoji Kitchen combinations eligible when emoji search has no query, before the user enters a search.Emoji Kitchen Scalingenable_emoji_kitchen_scalingAdjusts the rendered size of Emoji Kitchen stickers by changing how Gboard scales them.Emoji Predictor TFLITE Engineenable_emoji_predictor_tflite_engineRoutes Gboard's emoji prediction through its TensorFlow Lite model engine to generate emoji candidates.Emoji Suggestion From Top Candidateenable_emoji_suggestion_from_top_candidateBuilds emoji suggestions from the highest-ranked text suggestion, linking emoji prediction to the current text candidate.Emoji To Expressionenable_emoji_to_expressionSuggests related GIFs and stickers after you select an emoji in Gboard’s emoji keyboard.Emoji Variant Preferences Backupenable_emoji_variant_preferences_backupIncludes preferred emoji variants in backup data so they can be restored with other backed-up preferences.Emojify Modelenable_emojify_modelUses a model to suggest or apply emoji additions to text through Gboard's Emojify feature.Emojify Settings Optionenable_emojify_settings_optionAdds an Emojify option to Gboard settings when the feature is available to the keyboard.Expression Momentenable_expression_momentA contextual expression surface can bring stickers and Emoji Kitchen suggestions into view while you type.Expression Moment Push Up Animationenable_expression_moment_push_up_animationWhen it appears, the contextual expression surface slides upward into view with an animation.Gemma Embedding Emoji Kitchen Rankerenable_gemma_embedding_emoji_kitchen_rankerUses a Gemma-based model to compare Emoji Kitchen search matches and rank them by similarity; compatible model files are required.Lite Emoji Prediction Engineenable_lite_emoji_prediction_engineUses a lightweight emoji prediction engine when its required prediction files are available.Play Emoji Kitchen Mix Animationenable_play_emoji_kitchen_mix_animationEmoji Kitchen plays an animation when it combines two emoji into a sticker.Prewarming For Emoji Gemma Search Engine Activationenable_prewarming_for_emoji_gemma_search_engine_activationPreloads the Gemma model used by Emoji Kitchen search, so the model is ready before you start searching.Prioritize Recent Gifsenable_prioritize_recent_gifsRecently used GIFs appear earlier or more prominently in eligible GIF result lists.Proactive Emoji Kitchenenable_proactive_emoji_kitchenOffers Emoji Kitchen mashup stickers while you type, without requiring you to open the sticker browser first.Semantic Emojienable_semantic_emojiMatches emoji by meaning, so searches can return relevant results even when query words do not match emoji names.Sticker Predictions While Typingenable_sticker_predictions_while_typingPredicted stickers can appear in eligible suggestion surfaces while text is entered.Tenor Trending Gifsenable_tenor_trending_gifsTrending GIFs from Tenor can appear in Gboard's supported GIF browsing and search screens.

Flag Atlas / Predictions & corrections
Gboard Flag Atlas · Topic guide

Predictions & corrections

Word prediction, autocorrection, key correction and typing personalization.

18 independently described entries · 82 identifiers in the searchable catalog

Flag explanations

NWP Result Cachedisable_nwp_result_cachePrevents Gboard from reusing cached next-word prediction results, so predictions are calculated without that result cache.Auto-Correction Thresholdenable_ac_thresholdEnables an autocorrection confidence threshold, helping Gboard decide when a suggested replacement is reliable enough to apply automatically.Biasing For Past Correctionsenable_biasing_for_past_correctionsUses earlier corrections to influence later word suggestions, so repeated corrections can affect prediction ranking.Close Proactive Suggestions Access Pointenable_close_proactive_suggestions_access_pointAdds a dismissal action for proactive suggestion surfaces, allowing users to close these suggestions from their entry point.Correction Commit Animationenable_correction_commit_animationAnimates the moment Gboard commits an automatic correction, providing visible feedback that the typed text has changed.Inline Suggestions On Client Sideenable_inline_suggestions_on_client_sidePresents Smart Compose-style completions inline as you type, with Gboard handling their presentation instead of relying only on the suggestion strip.Inline Suggestions On Decoder Sideenable_inline_suggestions_on_decoder_sideProvides inline text completions from the decoder, placing suggestions in the text line rather than only in the suggestion strip.Key Correction Thresholdenable_kc_thresholdEnables a confidence threshold for key correction (KC), which helps Gboard decide when an imprecise tap should count as a nearby key.Multiword Predictions From User Historyenable_multiword_predictions_from_user_historyGenerates predictions spanning multiple words from typing history; this describes prediction generation, not whether suggestions appear in the suggestion strip.Multiword Suggestions From User Historyenable_multiword_suggestions_from_user_historyOffers phrase-length suggestions based on typing history in Gboard's suggestion strip, distinct from generating multiword predictions.NWP TFLITE Engineenable_nwp_tflite_engineUses TensorFlow Lite, a lightweight on-device machine-learning engine, to predict words you might type next.Post Correction Trigger Predictorenable_post_correction_trigger_predictorA predictor decides when to offer corrections after text has already been committed to the field.Spellchecker Chips UIenable_spellchecker_chips_uiSpell-check suggestions can appear as selectable chips, letting users choose a correction directly from the interface.TFLITE Smartkeys Modelenable_tflite_smartkeys_modelUses a TensorFlow Lite model to process key-touch input for Gboard’s Smartkeys feature.Triggering Modelenable_triggering_modelUses a model to decide when Gboard should activate certain prediction features, instead of triggering them solely through fixed rules.Ufc For Offsetenable_ufc_for_offsetUses personalized touch-offset information from Gboard’s User Feature Cache (UFC)—how far taps tend to land from key centers—to help interpret key presses.Ufc For Speedenable_ufc_for_speedUses typing-speed information from Gboard’s User Feature Cache (UFC), which retains learned typing characteristics. This is not a general keyboard speed boost.Language Models Observation Enabledpref_language_models_observation_enabledRemembers whether GboardWu records diagnostic information about loaded language models; it isn’t needed for everyday predictions.

Flag Atlas / Privacy & diagnostics
Gboard Flag Atlas · Topic guide

Privacy & diagnostics

Logging, debugging, privacy-sensitive settings, data retention and diagnostics.

17 independently described entries · 42 identifiers in the searchable catalog

Flag explanations

Auto Correction Statsenable_auto_correction_statsRecords auto-correction statistics for diagnostics; these are internal measurements, not a user-facing Gboard setting.Best Frame Search For Loggingenable_best_frame_search_for_loggingEnables a diagnostic search for the best frame to record in logs, rather than treating every captured frame equally.Conversation Id In Training Cacheenable_conversation_id_in_training_cacheStores conversation identifiers alongside records in Gboard’s internal training cache, creating a privacy-sensitive link to conversations.Debug Toast For Proactive Emoji Kitchenenable_debug_toast_for_proactive_emoji_kitchenDisplays diagnostic toast messages for proactive Emoji Kitchen suggestions, exposing debugging information rather than adding a user-facing suggestion control.Emoji Search Engine Debug Toastenable_emoji_search_engine_debug_toastShows temporary diagnostic pop-ups with information about Gboard's emoji-search activity during use.Export Pcv2 Revert Historyenable_export_pcv2_revert_historyExports records of corrections that were reversed in Gboard’s second-generation post-correction system (PCv2), useful for diagnosing unwanted edits.Export Ufcenable_export_ufcAllows data to be exported from Gboard’s User Feature Cache (UFC), which holds learned typing-related information. The exported fields and destination are undocumented.Internal Speech Enhancement Pii Loggingenable_internal_speech_enhancement_pii_loggingAllows diagnostic logs related to internal speech enhancement to include personally identifiable information (PII).Logging For Emoji Search Queryenable_logging_for_emoji_search_queryLogs Emoji search queries for diagnostics, creating privacy-sensitive records of users’ search terms.Muse Debugenable_muse_debugEnables debugging for Muse Writing Tools, supporting investigation of issues in its writing features.On Device Metrics Aggregationenable_on_device_metrics_aggregationAggregates usage metrics on the device for diagnostic analysis of Gboard usage.Save Audio History To Fileenable_save_audio_history_to_fileSaves dictation audio history to a local file, which can retain audio beyond transcription and has privacy implications.Smartkeys Heatmapsenable_smartkeys_heatmapsSupports heatmaps showing where keys are touched during Smart Keys experiments, for internal analysis.Spatial Statsenable_spatial_statsTouch-position statistics are recorded for internal use; this does not describe a user-facing keyboard feature.Spell Checker Statsenable_spell_checker_statsDiagnostic statistics can be recorded for Gboard spelling checks; this concerns measurement, not a visible correction option.Training Cache Db Walenable_training_cache_db_walUses SQLite's write-ahead logging, a method for recording database changes, for Gboard's training cache.Typo Statsenable_typo_statsCollects typo statistics for internal use; this does not describe a direct Gboard feature.

Other Networkallow_other_networkLets a networking library reuse cached domain-name lookup results after a network change; this does not describe a Gboard interface option.Ondevice Auto Downloaddisable_ondevice_auto_downloadStops automatic downloading of on-device resources; features requiring those resources may not work until they are available.Autofill Ime Integrationenable_autofill_ime_integrationConnects Gboard with Android autofill so it can coordinate keyboard text entry with filling form fields.Camera Permission Overlayenable_camera_permission_overlayAdds a camera-permission prompt when a Gboard tool requests camera-based scanning, making the required access request visible.Device Intelligenceenable_device_intelligenceProvides an integration path between Gboard and Android's device-intelligence capabilities; supported services vary by device.Email Provider Completionenable_email_provider_completionProvides completion suggestions for email providers as users enter an email address.Fast Access Barenable_fast_access_barAdds a quick-access emoji row above the keyboard with frequent or preset emoji; an app allowlist may limit where it appears.MDD Metadata Cleanupenable_mdd_metadata_cleanupClears obsolete metadata from Google’s Mobile Data Download (MDD) system, which manages downloaded keyboard resources; it doesn’t delete the models themselves.Nga Lab Modeless Smarteditenable_nga_lab_modeless_smarteditEnables Smart Edit interactions in the NGA lab without preventing users from interacting with other parts of the app.P13n Contact Phoneenable_p13n_contact_phoneTests personalizing text suggestions with contact and phone information; APK research has not established exactly which data is used.PK Simulatorenable_pk_simulatorExposes an experimental accessibility keyboard layout, not a simulator for an external hardware keyboard.Settings Searchenable_settings_searchAdds search to Gboard settings so users can find options without browsing each settings section.Si Shortcut Keysenable_si_shortcut_keysAdds keyboard shortcuts for Super Insert, Gboard's panel for inserting items such as clipboard content, emoji, and saved text.Signboardenable_signboardExposes Sign-to-Text for camera-based sign-language transcription; a separate component download is required.Socket Recv Optimizationenable_socket_recv_optimizationThe bundled QUIC networking stack can use an optimized UDP receive path; this does not alter Gboard's layout or suggestions.Sqlite Release Memoryenable_sqlite_release_memoryThe flag lets Gboard release memory held by SQLite databases more proactively.Text Conversionenable_text_conversionConverts text as you type in supported writing systems, especially those used by East Asian input methods.Tnt Continuous Decodingenable_tnt_continuous_decodingKeeps the TNT decoder processing input continuously, rather than treating every segment as a separate decoding operation.Reset Streaming After No Statesforce_reset_streaming_after_no_statesForces an active streaming process to reset when it runs out of valid processing states, rather than continuing from an empty state.Key Jetson Close Iconpref_key_jetson_close_iconStores the close-button icon setting for an internal Gboard interface called Jetson; it doesn't control the keyboard's main toolbar.Lan FTP Enabledpref_lan_ftp_enabledRecords whether Gboard's local-network FTP service is enabled; enabling it exposes a file-transfer service on the local network.Long Press Quick Actions Enabledpref_long_press_quick_actions_enabledControls whether Gboard enables its long-press quick actions, including editing shortcuts for text.Manual Incognito Feature Enabledpref_manual_incognito_feature_enabledStores whether the manual incognito control is enabled in this Gboard build.Simple Calculator Enabledpref_simple_calculator_enabledRemembers whether GboardWu’s inline calculator is enabled, allowing recognized calculations to appear in the suggestion strip.Dominating Conv Iduse_dominating_conv_idSelects the dominant conversation ID when multiple conversation identifiers are available, keeping related input tied to one context.Stale On Name Not Resolveduse_stale_on_name_not_resolvedReuses a cached DNS result when a fresh lookup fails because the requested name cannot be resolved.
